title: Shop page
summary: The Shop tab / page: special offer, bundles, coin packs, purchase flow with sparkles and toasts.
description: ShopView lays out the catalogue (1 special offer, bundles, coin packs) with live StoreKit prices, buys through the store service and plays the coin fly / sparkles; ShopEconomy is the economy table the shell's own actions use (refill, booster pack). Opens as the home's Shop tab or as a closable page over an offer.
gaps: ShopView borrows LeftText (ProfileView.swift), SunburstRays (NoLivesPopup.swift) and TopPill / HomeLive / CoinPillDisplay (home).
